'''Krozurbia''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim's]] [[Shadola sector/Legends|Shadola sector]].<ref name="TEAOC" /> It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Krozurbian]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. They were engaged in two hundred years of war until peace was brought about due to the intervention of the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Zorneth]].<ref name="SOR4" />
